title: Review the strategy against the evidence

steps.do: Read every validation record, competitor signal, decision and money figure since the last review, citing each by route.
Write the diagnosis, guiding policy and coherent actions the records support, and say plainly where they hold only goals.
Check each live bet's kill criteria and raise a decision for the founder when one is met or has no date.
Compare intended with realized strategy and the default-alive test, and raise a change of customer, product or model when the evidence contradicts the current one.
Propose the next assumption to test and update the goal drafts, raising the order to the strategy lead.

done_criteria.check: Is every strategic choice the evidence put in question either confirmed by the founder or open as a decision with options and evidence?
